evidence.method: agent-prepared: pin numbers/names and pad multiset diffed against the installed KiCad 10.0.6 symbol and footprint files; no datasheet read
evidence.notes: Scope: pad count, pad numbers and symbol pin numbers only. Pad multiset 1x2, 2x2 taken from the footprint file.

notes: Uno-toggle SW1/SW2. 4 legs = 2 pads numbered 1 and 2 twice each (pads in parallel pairs): the symbol shows only 2 pins. Orientation matters on a real 6 mm switch (the two internally joined pairs run along one axis), which the pad numbering encodes: unverified against the actual switch.
